about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a full-stack developer based in Tashkent. I work with NestJS, PostgreSQL and Redis on the backend and Next.js and React on the frontend. I have shipped real projects with payment systems (Click, Payme, Uzum Bank, Atmos), Telegram bots and automation (n8n). I study FinTech at Tashkent State University of Economics.
